What does carpet installation cost in Arlington, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Arlington — carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away included. A single bedroom typically comes in around $600–$1,000, and most whole projects land between $2,400 and $3,900. The carpet grade you pick swings the total more than anything else, and you pick it from samples laid out in your own house, not from a rack.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come out to Arlington?

Yes — Arlington is regular territory for the van. It shows up with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, we set the samples in the rooms they'd actually go in so the color reads true in your own light, then measure every room and stair. You get a written price before the visit ends, the visit is free, and you skip the drive to a store in Everett or Lynnwood.
What does it cost to stretch carpet in Arlington?

Carpet stretching starts at $99 per room in Arlington, and most rooms come in between $99 and $180. A power stretcher pulls ripples, waves and trip hazards flat for roughly a fifth of what new carpet costs — so when the pile still stands up and you still like the color, stretching wins.
What do carpeted stairs run in Arlington?

Stair installation starts at $18 per step, done waterfall or cap-and-band style. A typical straight staircase usually totals somewhere in the $235–$400 range depending on the carpet you choose. Landings and pie-shaped winders are measured and priced in the written quote from the start, so nothing gets added on afterward.
How long will my carpet installation take?

One day handles most Arlington houses. Three or four rooms plus a staircase is a normal day's work for the crew; a whole house with heavy furniture or extra stairs can carry into a second day. The timeline is written on your quote, so you know before we start.
Do you move the furniture, or is that on me?

We handle the big pieces. Beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs, and everything goes back where it stood. Your part is the small stuff — closet floors, electronics, breakables and anything else you'd rather move with your own hands.
Should I stretch my carpet or start over with new?

Stretch when the pile still stands up, the backing is sound and the color still works for you — that's a $99-per-room fix instead of a full replacement. Replace when traffic lanes are matted flat, seams are pulling apart, the backing is crumbling, or pet odor has survived a professional cleaning. We look first and tell you straight which one you've got.
Which Arlington neighborhoods does OC Flooring cover?

All of them — old town around Olympic Avenue, Gleneagle, Kent Prairie, Arlington Heights, Sisco Heights and the newer subdivisions out toward Smokey Point and 172nd. The van also runs regularly to Marysville, Stanwood, Silvana, Bryant, Trafton, Granite Falls, Lake Stevens and the rest of north Snohomish County.
What carpet holds up best with dogs and cats?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, sitting on a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier keeps accidents from soaking into the subfloor — that soak is what makes odor permanent — and solution-dyed fiber holds its color even under diluted bleach cleaning. The moisture-barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and we bring pet-focused samples on every Arlington visit.
What warranty comes with the install?

Every install carries OC Flooring's 1-year workmanship warranty, and the carpet itself carries its mill warranty — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on the grade. Both go on your written quote. Worth knowing: some mill warranties require a certain pad grade, which is one more reason all three grades ride out in the van.
